name: Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited
summary: Current issuer-side entity for USDY after the product was folded into the Ondo Global Markets umbrella in December 2025.
notes: USDY documentation distinguishes the product from a traditional stablecoin and describes it as a tokenized secured note.

name: Circle International Bermuda Limited
summary: Bermuda-regulated Circle entity that issues and administers USYC on behalf of its underlying Cayman mutual fund.
notes: Separate from the existing broad Circle organization record to preserve the current USYC legal issuer identity.

name: Hashnote International Short Duration Yield Fund Ltd.
summary: Cayman Islands mutual fund whose shares are represented onchain by USYC and whose portfolio includes short-term U.S. Treasury and reverse-repo exposures.
notes: USYC holders hold a tokenized fund-share interest rather than a conventional stablecoin claim.
